maria g: Weekend push  planning to drop coordinated X + LinkedIn posts tied to Tuesday's webinar. Need final assets, CTAs, and lead routing confirmation. who can take copy + schedule?
jon r: I can handle copy and scheduler. suggest CTA = "register for the webinar" + secondary CTA "watch on demand" for later.
samir: timing recs: X posts Friday 10:30am PT and Saturday 11am PT, LI posts Saturday 11:30am PT. spikes look better Friday evening but we'll follow the webinar nurture.
olivia: drafted 3 copy variations, short thread + longform post. dropping below. please pick fav and request image sizes.
olivia: ```
Option A (short, punchy): "Ship inference that scales  join our webinar on Tuesday to see how teams cut token cost and latency. Register: <link> #inference #mlops"
Option B (narrative): "We rebuilt inference to make LLMs predictable in production. Join our engineers on Tuesday to see the benchmarks, tradeoffs, and rollout playbook. Register: <link>"
Option C (benchmark lead): "Benchmarks reveal 3x token cost savings with smart batching. See the full breakdown in our webinar. Save your seat: <link>"
```
kyle: routing  confirm that webinar form includes utm params and webhook to /leads/inbound. pls use utm_source=x_weekend, utm_campaign=launch_v1, uid param. SDR rotation: @sales will pick leads with tag "webinar-launch".
maria g: kyle can you post the exact register link with params? need to wire to scheduler.
kyle: here: https://go.redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=x_weekend&utm_campaign=launch_v1&utm_medium=social&ref=threads
jon r: nice. i'll generate final post copy using Option B + short thread variant. can we get image assets?
olivia: sending three image crops to drive now  1200x675 for X, 1200x627 for LI feed, square 1080 for carousel. link: https://drive.redwood/launch-assets (visible to marketing).
samir: social-bot reminder: suggested cadence = 1x pinned X thread + 2 followups (teaser + proofpoint). can we schedule followups Mon + Tue AM?
social-bot: Reminder queued: schedule window open. use /schedule with workspace tag #marketing and attach image.
maria g: timeline: final copy + image by EOD today, schedule posted to scheduler by Jon, test link + form by Kyle. SDR handoff doc in confluence -> I'll link once set.
jon r: on it, booking slots in scheduler. will post draft in #marketing for quick ack before publish. :thumbsup:
kyle: will validate webhook and test a dummy lead today at 5pm PT. will post results here.
maria g: perfect. if anyone sees the copy swallowing the UTM (it happened last time), ping me immediately.
olivia: quick note  for LI, add 2-line pull quote at top for better CTR.
samir: ok locking times and creative. thanks team, let's amplify. :rocket:
